description: This Java class 'Wizard' provides a GUI component for a trigger configuration wizard within a larger application. It includes nested classes for different wizard steps, handles command sending, UI interactions, and waiting for RPM to reach zero.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: Main class representing the trigger configuration wizard UI component with embedded step handling logic.

classes.name: WizardStep
classes.description: Interface defining a step in the wizard, requiring a getContent() method.

classes.name: WizardStepImpl
classes.description: Abstract class implementing WizardStep, providing nextStep management.

classes.name: SendCommand
classes.description: Wizard step that sends a command to the device and proceeds to the next step upon confirmation.

classes.name: WaitForZeroRpm
classes.description: Wizard step that waits until the RPM sensor reports zero RPM before proceeding.

methods.name: createPane
methods.description: Creates and returns the main panel UI for the wizard, initializing button actions.

methods.name: applyStep
methods.description: Transitions to the given wizard step, updating UI content.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Prepares and returns the UI component for a specific wizard step.

methods.name: scheduleRepaint
methods.description: Sets up a timer to re-invoke the wizard step after a delay.
